rv.q: To ask a roomful of strangers to trust each other, to ask the actor to trust an audience with this kind of blind faith, is a transformative experience.
I highly recommend 'White Rabbit Red Rabbit' to anyone who's spontaneous and looking for something completely different.
TUTA's White Rabbit, Red Rabbit asks us to think about the rules and how we might upend them.
Theatre is full of surprises, but few plays redefine the boundaries of live performance like White Rabbit Red Rabbit, the brilliant and daring creation by Iranian playwright Nassim Soleimanpour.
This performance really gets your heart rate going and starts a strong conversation.
The actor proved quick on his feet as he made good use of the stage and was excellent at tackling this interesting experimental piece.

cn.t: Critics praise this experimental Iranian play as a brilliant, daring theatrical experience that redefines live performance through its unique cold-read format, blending humor and vulnerability into an unpredictable, engrossing night of spontaneity and trust.
